confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login, followed by unauthorized privilege escalation, cross-departmental data exfiltration, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (23.129.64.222) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the same suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_04 elevated their role to admin.
Data exfiltration begins: bulk downloading of files across multiple departments (marketing, devops, security, hr, engineering) that are outside the user's normal finance directory.
Anti-forensics: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 23.129.64.222 is a known VPN or proxy used by the company.
Confirmation of whether user_04's credentials were compromised via phishing or if this was a direct insider threat.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_04's account after a series of failed login attempts from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin and performed a bulk download of sensitive files across nearly every department before deleting the authentication logs to conceal the activity.
